raw_text: Several images showing enormous crowds at farmer protest sites near Delhi have been identified as AI-generated by fact-checking organizations. The images contained telltale generative artifacts including distorted hands, inconsistent shadows, and duplicated facial patterns. While the farmer march itself drew significant participation, these specific viral images were fabricated to exaggerate turnout. Reverse image searches found no matching photographs in any news archive.
clean_text: AI-generated images of farmer protests identified with distorted hands, inconsistent shadows, and duplicated faces. Actual march had significant turnout but these images fabricated.
